map.干绝热(9.8°C/km)与露点直减(约 2°C/km)之差约 8°C/km，换: The difference between the dry adiabatic lapse rate (9.8°C/km) and the dew point lapse rate (about 2°C/km) is about 8°C/km, which converts to about 125 m per °C; the empirical figure used is 122 m (400 ft).

map.是近似，假设云由地面空气抬升凝结而成；层云较准，积云因对流会偏低。: It is an approximation, assuming clouds form by condensation of air lifted from the ground; it is more accurate for stratus, while cumulus tends to come out low because of convection.

map.由气温与露点差，按经验规则 H ≈ (T − Td) × 125（米/℃）估算云: Estimate cloud base height from the air temperature and dew point difference with the empirical rule H ≈ (T − Td) × 125 (m/°C).

map.航空/通航判断云底是否够低影响起降。: For aviation and general aviation, judging whether the cloud base is low enough matters for take-off and landing.
map.预报员用干湿球差快速估云高。: Forecasters use the wet-bulb depression to estimate cloud height quickly.
map.：气温 20°C、露点 10°C，温差 10°C → 云底高度=10/2.5×1: : air temperature 20°C, dew point 10°C, difference 10°C → cloud base = 10/2.5×1000 = 4000 ft ≈ 1220 m (the empirical rate is about 400 ft per °C of difference).
map.：温差仅 2°C → 云底≈800 ft≈240 m，属低云，通航需谨慎。: : a difference of only 2°C → cloud base ≈ 800 ft ≈ 240 m, a low cloud, so flying needs caution.
